reading_workflow.image_proxies: The original whole JPEG and same-dimension quality95 JPEG proxies of both native halves were visually read.
reading_workflow.line_count_detail: Eleven physical manuscript prose/math baselines, plus the separate foliation baseline. The reverse machine rows are excluded source layers and are not counted as manuscript lines.
reading_workflow.crop_rule: One saved first crop for each designated place; no crop was recut or replaced. The large bleed-through crop was viewed through its same-dimension quality95 JPEG proxy.
reading_workflow.root_review: Root independently viewed the whole, both native halves and all eight crops; the uncertainty between obliteration and dash is retained after comparison.
reading_workflow.agreed_text: Every agreed manuscript word, letter, index, exponent, sign and punctuation place was read from the halves; the entire formulas were read around open signs.
reading_workflow.boundaries: Only scan039 packet, its supplied current notation snapshot and its own original/half/crop images were read. No OCR, web research or TeX compilation.
reading_workflow.excluded_blind_items: Reverse-print glyphs and the absent next-page heading are not nominated as alternative current-page manuscript words.

changes.place: first line: heavy horizontal mark before e1
changes.ink: A short, dense horizontal patch lies between base and the first e1. Its uneven thick edges favour an obliteration, but no underletters certify cancellation rather than a heavy dash. Both states are retained in doubt without supplying a former letter.
The single verb retains an initial c, the tall h, low a-n joins, a g with its long lower loop and an e before the terminal dark patch. The surviving word is change.

changes.place: second line: scope of opening corrections
changes.ink: The first strike ends after revient à. The following change is the only occurrence of that verb; a separate dense patch covers its final remnant, tentatively r. The p-led word to its right has its own strike. There is no second complete changer or change elsewhere on the line.

changes.place: second line: separately cancelled word after change
changes.ink: The short cancelled word has a descending p stem and low rounded strokes under the horizontal strike. Par remains a tentative reading; the last joins are not fully exposed.
The long horizontal line lies below the letter bodies and crosses only the descending g and f strokes. The word remains live and underlined.
The P has two distinct parallel vertical stems beneath its upper bowl. The raised 1, set-difference stroke and full excluded set 0, plus-or-minus 2, infinity were read together.

changes.place: second paragraph: supposed stop after the projective formula
changes.ink: The closing brace is followed by blank paper. No independent full stop is visible after it before the next manuscript line begins Elle.
